text:
maria-peopleops: Heads up — candidate Ethan Li (IC4) needs an earlier start due to visa slot on May 6. Current offer is set for May 20. Can we approve a start-date exception + one-time relocation sign-on?
ashwin-recruiter: manager asked for May 6 because embassy appointment moved. Ethan is firm on that date. Do we need compband uplift or just sign-on?
devin-hiringmgr: We can make the sign-on work. We discussed bumping to IC5 given market comp, but budget is tight. If people-ops + finance sign off on a one-time $6k sign-on and accelerated onboarding, i'm ok with leaving band as-is.
sarah-finance: Quick check: one-time sign-on of $6k is fine if POKM approves charge code and we mark it as relocation sign-on (non-recurring). Will need PO ticket and GL string. Also confirm salary stays within IC4 range, not uplifted.
maria-peopleops: Noted. We need formal approval from comp-committee if we uplift band or change base. Since Devin wants same band + sign-on, we can route quick-approve. Please confirm final numbers so I can enter into Workday and trigger preboarding.
jess-peopleops: Routing: tagging comp-committee for visibility and formal sign-off. @comp-committee please ACK: one-time $6,000 relocation sign-on, start date 2024-05-06, no base salary change, manager (devin) requests expedited onboarding. Policy snippet: "One-time relocation sign-ons <= $10k can be approved by People Ops + Finance; base changes require comp-committee."
offer-bot: Offer packet created draft: base $135,000 (IC4 midpoint), sign-on $6,000 (relocation), start 2024-05-06. Link: https://offers.internal/redwood/ethan_li
ashwin-recruiter: i filed PO ticket #PO-4721 and attached passport/visa note. Putting candidate on expedited background check slot.
sarah-finance: ACK PO charge ok. Please set expense GL to RELO-TRAVEL-01.
comp-committee (via jess-peopleops): APPROVED via thread: sign-on $6k, start 2024-05-06, no band uplift.
jess-peopleops: thanks all — i'll update Workday and send the finalized offer package to Ethan this afternoon. :party:
